title: gyrinops moluccana
intro: Gyrinops moluccana, commonly known as Moluccan ironwood or ironwood tree, is a plant species native to the Moluccas, an island chain in Indonesia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and inflammation, thanks to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Gyrinops moluccana include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as irin, a lignan glycoside. The bioactive constituents of Gyrinops moluccana also include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
